rationale: Elias is shipping consumer AI products with deep conviction around building for the current technological moment, while Junfan is actively researching and building agentic AI systems with LLMs—both in San Francisco and both working across LLM tooling and ml-infra. Junfan's 5+ years in agentic reinforcement learning and multimodal reasoning, combined with his open-source contributions (LangGraph, LangSmith projects), could directly inform how Elias architectures Lee-AI's next generation, and Elias's conviction around speed and staying current with the tech stack aligns with Junfan's drive to push world models and embodied intelligence forward.
intro_message: Elias Schwalme, meet Junfan Zhu — you're both building at the intersection of LLMs and practical AI systems in SF, and Junfan's depth in agentic frameworks and multimodal reasoning could be valuable as you scale Lee-AI.
